entry: Neighbouring district: from round 3 you can open a second region with its own starting profile (lots of housing, no integration services, little money, higher pressure), run alongside yours every round. When your region is calm and holds a cushion you can send it support, and a neighbour left in critical strain pushes extra arrivals into yours (I1, I7).
Second wave: once most arrivals have integrated, a larger wave (twice the arrivals for five rounds) tests whether your capacity holds, announced a round ahead and ending with a plain verdict (I25).
Cross-region learning: bringing any region to Thriving once gives every region you start afterwards +10% faster integration (I29).
Policy toolkit: fund Streamlined Credentialing, Language-Access Funding and Community Sponsorship, three named institutional levers with up to three levels each (I3).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).
Fixed the investment buttons row overflowing the screen edge on narrow phones.

Capped the per-round history logs (arrivals/strain/wellbeing/sub-score) so long sessions no longer grow an unbounded save -- the lifetime strain average and the critical-strain-recovery achievement still work correctly, unaffected by the cap.
Fixed a display bug where the Achievements/Settings panels showed as empty boxes before their first open and never visually closed again once opened once.

Round-2 polish: capacity forecast, next-milestone estimate, investment ROI, sub-score trend arrows, control line on the trend graph, region naming, Crisis Start mode, capacity reallocation, and a coda legacy choice.
Settings panel: adjustable text size and a Reduce Motion toggle.
Colorblind-safety audit: wellbeing line on the trend graph now dashed, not just a different color.
Achievements added: 18 achievements, in-game panel, unlock toast, hub dashboard link.
Skippable tutorial, a How to Play page, and a mobile sticky HUD.
Space-theme visual pass and a full redesign of the content window.
Save/load added via the shared save widget, so progress carries across devices.
Pass 3: a clear "turning point" callout the moment integration becomes net-positive, plus a sharper feedback question.
Info Page added: real-world sources on climate displacement and institutional preparedness.
Pass 2: Long-Horizon Outcomes coda showing the region's generational payoff.
Pass 1: three-bar wellbeing dashboard, mid-run checkpoint summary, and case-study context blurbs.
All 7 core milestones shipped: allocation loop, displacement pressure, strain vs. capacity, integration payoff, composite wellbeing scoring, feedback prompt, visual/hub pass.
